points.en: Zebu cattle (Bos indicus) most dominant; frequently depicted on Harappan seals.
points.hi: Zebu cattle (Bos indicus) most dominant; frequently depicted on Harappan seals.

points.en: Sheep, goats, pigs, and buffalo widely kept for meat, milk, and traction.
points.hi: Sheep, goats, pigs, and buffalo widely kept for meat, milk, and traction.

points.en: Equids (horses/asses) debated; camel bones found at specific sites.
points.hi: Equids (horses/asses) debated; camel bones found at specific sites.

points.en: Domesticated fowl (chicken) present; wild game supplemented diet.

points.en: Harappa & Mohenjo-daro: Terracotta figurines and animal bones confirm cattle and sheep dominance.
points.hi: Harappa & Mohenjo-daro: Terracotta figurines and animal bones confirm cattle and sheep dominance.

points.en: Dholavira: Evidence of advanced water management supporting pastoralism.
points.hi: Dholavira: Evidence of advanced water management supporting pastoralism.

points.en: Surkotada: Definite early horse remains (archaeozoological debate persists).
points.hi: Surkotada: Definite early horse remains (archaeozoological debate persists).

misconception.en: Horses were the primary domesticated animal of the Harappans.
misconception.hi: Horses were the primary domesticated animal of the Harappans.

correction.en: Humped cattle (zebu) were overwhelmingly the primary domesticated animal; horse presence is scarce and debated.
correction.hi: Humped cattle (zebu) were overwhelmingly the primary domesticated animal; horse presence is scarce and debated.

fiveFacts.en: Zebu cattle was the premier domesticated animal in IVC.
fiveFacts.hi: IVC में ज़ेबू मवेशी प्रमुख पालतू जानवर थे।

fiveFacts.en: Sheep, goats, and water buffalo were vital for Harappan pastoralism.
fiveFacts.hi: भेड़, बकरियाँ और भैंस हड़प्पा कालीन पशुपालन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण थीं।

fiveFacts.en: Camel bones are specifically recorded at certain mature Harappan sites.
fiveFacts.hi: कुछ परिपक्व हड़प्पा स्थलों पर विशेष रूप से ऊँट की हड्डियाँ दर्ज की गई हैं।

fiveFacts.en: Surkotada yields debated archaeozoological evidence of horse bones.
fiveFacts.hi: सुरकोटडा से घोड़े की हड्डियों के विवादास्पद पुराप्राणीवैज्ञानिक (archaeozoological) साक्ष्य मिलते हैं।

fiveFacts.en: Terracotta figurines provide primary artistic proof of domesticated species.
fiveFacts.hi: टेराकोटा की मूर्तियाँ पालतू प्रजातियों के प्राथमिक कलात्मक प्रमाण प्रदान करती हैं।

threeTraps.en: Assuming horses were central to Harappan transport.
threeTraps.hi: यह मान लेना कि घोड़े हड़प्पा कालीन परिवहन के लिए केंद्रीय थे।

threeTraps.en: Confusing wild fauna representations (like the unicorn or tiger) with domesticated livestock.
threeTraps.hi: जंगली जीवों के चित्रण (जैसे एकसृंगीय/यूनिकॉर्न या बाघ) को पालतू पशुधन के साथ मिला देना।

threeTraps.en: Neglecting faunal remains data from archaeological excavation reports.
threeTraps.hi: पुरातत्व उत्खनन रिपोर्टों के जीव-अवशेष (faunal remains) डेटा की उपेक्षा करना।
